Just got back from seeing Ant-Man, it was better than I expected. What did you all think?

I was not previously familiar with Ant-Man, but now I'm a fan. Some of my favorite things (without being spoilery):

  • Pre-suit parkour and MacGyver skills-- this is a superhero who isn't going to be relying on just the suit.

  • The heist crew-- I hope to see more of them

  • Anthony the ant

  • The Avenger interaction

  • Even though the movie didn't pass the so-called Bechtel test, the main female character was interesting and had an important role to play.
Just FYI the bechtel test is a joke from a lesbian comic strip, it has nothing to do with anything professional.

Just FYI, that doesn't mean it can't be an interesting observation to make regarding casting choices. Guardians of the Galaxy "passed" for instance.

But if you want to get down to it-- and understand I enjoyed the film fine as is and am not saying it should have been cast differently-- there was no plot reason that I could see that all members of the heist crew were men. That said, the one with the sideburns was easy on the eyes....
